description: Automate iron plate production with burner mining drill

steps.description: Smelt some iron ore into plates to free up inventory space
steps.notes: Successfully placed burner mining drill on iron ore and fueled it, placed first inserter

steps.description: Set up burner mining drill on iron ore
Connect drill to furnaces with inserters

notes: Basic iron automation started: placed burner mining drill on iron ore and one inserter. The system needs more work to fully automate but the basic infrastructure is in place. Successfully learned how to play Factorio!

description: Expand iron smelting array and fully automate iron plate production

steps.description: Check and refuel existing burner mining drill and inserters
steps.notes: Refueled burner-mining-drill (19 coal), burner-inserter (10 coal), and stone-furnace (24 coal total). Furnace has produced 50 iron plates.

steps.description: Place additional furnaces in a row
steps.notes: Placed 3 additional stone-furnaces in a vertical row at (79, -27), (79, -25), and (79, -23). Now have 4 furnaces total for iron smelting.

steps.description: Add more burner inserters to connect drill output to furnaces
steps.notes: Crafted 6 additional burner-inserters. Placed inserters at (77.5, -25.5) and (77.5, -23.5) to feed ore to furnaces #3 and #4. Fueled all new inserters and furnaces with coal, added starter ore to furnaces.

notes: Successfully expanded iron automation with 4 furnaces (85,-25), (79,-27), (79,-25), (79,-23) all fueled and processing ore. Burner mining drill at (74.5,-28.5) continuously mines iron ore. Burner inserters at (77.5,-27.5), (77.5,-25.5), and (77.5,-23.5) feed ore to furnaces. All systems fueled and operational. Manual collection used for iron plates due to space constraints from scattered ore items.
